<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cornered Animal](/Feats.aspx?ID=5499) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
<trait label="Flourish" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=606" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 78

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

**Requirements**
You are in animal or hybrid form and are flanked.

</column>

---

You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies. You make [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=719) Strikes against two different creatures flanking you. The attacks take a –2 penalty if the unarmed weapon is not agile. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made both of them.
name: Cornered Animal
requirement: You are in animal or hybrid form and are flanked.
requirement_markdown: You are in animal or hybrid form and are flanked.
